2026 年 9 月 12 日有多名董事及大股东申报股权变动。
2026 年 9 月 23 日公告「多项提案」。
risks: 附加股发行涉及 313,707,585 股新股及 39,213,441 张凭单，可能对现有股东权益产生摊薄影响。

PARKWD - RENOUNCEABLE RIGHTS ISSUE OF 313,707,585 NEW ORDINARY SHARES IN PARKWD ("PARKWD SHARES") ("RIGHTS SHARES") TOGETHER WITH 39,213,441 FREE DETACHABLE WARRANTS ("WARRANTS") ON THE BASIS OF 2 RIGHTS SHARES FOR EVERY 1 EXISTING PARKWD SHARE HELD AND 1 WARRANT FOR EVERY 8 RIGHTS SHARES SUBSCRIBED

recent_en: PARKWD completed a renounceable rights issue with free warrants in September 2025, with the new shares and warrants listed on 10 September 2025. In September 2026, there were multiple filings on changes in director and substantial shareholder interests, along with a 'multiple proposals' announcement. The latest quarterly report covers the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
notable_en: Completed a rights issue with free warrants; the new shares and warrants were listed on 10 September 2025.
On 12 September 2026, several directors and substantial shareholders filed changes in their interests.
On 23 September 2026, a 'multiple proposals' announcement was made.
risks_en: The rights issue involved 313,707,585 new shares and 39,213,441 warrants, which may have a dilutive effect on existing shareholders.
Several directors and substantial shareholders filed changes in their interests on 12 September 2026; subsequent shareholding changes should be monitored.
